self_verification.evidence_quote: an independent MLLM judge double-checks the verdict
self_verification.note: Completion Gate is prompt-level self-verification; Verifier and Loop Breaker Tier 3 are separate model judges.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The final decision of task termination requires both checking modules to agree on task completion.
retry_policy.note: Rejection returns the agent to acting until verifier accepts or step budget runs out.

rollback.evidence_quote: On rejection decisions, the rejection reasons are appended to the trajectory so that subsequent actions are aware of them.
rollback.note: No undo/snapshot/git revert mechanism described; recovery is by new actions.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: All agents on both benchmarks operate in iterative planning mode with a per-task step budget of maximum 100 actions.
termination_condition.note: agent.done()/agent.fail() are model-declared terminals; Loop Breaker detects stalls (escalates rather than halting).
